meta.title: MDC Roadmap: career pathways starting at Miami Dade College
meta.notes: Florida-resident tuition and required fees only. Verify with MDConnect / an MDC advisor before relying on any requirement.

transfer_rules.aa_guarantee: An MDC AA guarantees admission to a Florida public university, not to a limited-access program.
fiu_default: C or higher in all prerequisites

fiu_exceptions.engineering: C or higher in two attempts or fewer (drops/withdrawals count); Calculus I ready
fiu_exceptions.architecture: 3.0 GPA, AA in Architectural Studies, design portfolio

transfer_rules.as_to_bachelors: AS courses don't all count as university gen-ed; MDC's own BS/BAS programs accept the AS directly.

careers.title: Architect
careers.summary: MDC AA (Architecture, 10200) -> FIU Accelerated Master of Architecture -> NCARB AXP + ARE -> Florida license.

duties: Meet clients to set goals and budgets
Prepare contract documents and visit construction sites

primary_program.name: Architecture Pathway
primary_program.note: FIU also requires ARC 2303, 2304, 2172 and 2580 (additional common prerequisites), so plan ~78 credits.

fiu_transfer.degree: Accelerated Master of Architecture (master's only, no bachelor's awarded)
admission: C or higher in all pre-graduate courses
Design portfolio via Get Acceptd (opens Sept 1, final deadline Jan 15, decisions by Mar 31)
fiu_transfer.program: Enter at third year; 102 graduate credits over 3-4 years; NAAB-accredited, STEM-designated

other_transfer: FAMU B.S. Architectural Studies (limited access, 2.5 GPA)

stages.note: Range = undergraduate vs graduate per-credit rate

licensure_steps: Pass all divisions of the ARE (AXP participation required before testing)
Apply to Florida Board of Architecture and Interior Design (no reciprocity; endorsement for out-of-state)
24 CE hours per 2-year cycle (22 HSW + 2 Florida Building Code)
experience: Build a studio portfolio every term
Firm internships from the summer after year 1

careers.title: Mechanical Engineer
careers.summary: MDC AA (Engineering-Mechanical, 10911) -> FIU BSME (ABET) -> FE -> ~4 yrs experience -> PE.

duties: Analyze problems mechanical/thermal devices can solve
career_exploration.entry_education: Bachelor's in mechanical engineering or ME technology; PE not needed to start

primary_program.name: Engineering - Mechanical Pathway
primary_program.note: 60 credits reach Calculus 3; FIU also needs MAP 2302, PHY 2049/L, COP 2270, EGN 2312 (~76 credits).

courses.title: Calculus & Analytic Geometry 1
prerequisites: MAC 1140 + MAC 1114, or MAC 1106 + MAC 1114, or MAC 1147

courses.title: Physics with Calculus 1
prerequisites: HS physics or PHY 1025 or PHY 2053

admission: C or higher in all prerequisites in two attempts or fewer (drops/withdrawals count)
Calculus I ready: MAC 1140 + MAC 1114, or MAC 1147, each C or higher

prerequisites.note: Transfers as noted for ME majors
Transfers as noted for ME majors

other_transfer: FAMU-FSU College of Engineering ME (2.0 GPA)
UF / UCF / USF via statewide AA articulation

licensure_steps: NCEES FE exam (usually senior year or right after graduation)
FBPE Engineer Intern certification: ABET degree, FE pass, $100 fee, Laws & Rules study guide 90%+
~4 years qualifying experience under a PE
NCEES PE exam (Mechanical); PE application $230, renewal $98.75
experience: Co-ops/internships from the summer after Calculus 2

careers.title: Chef
careers.summary: MDC AS Culinary Arts Management (22031) -> kitchen experience -> MDC BAS Supervision & Management - Hospitality -> optional FIU M.S. Hospitality.

career_exploration.entry_education: High school diploma + 5+ years related experience (BLS)

mdc_bachelor.name: Supervision and Management - Hospitality Management
admission: AA, AS or AAS, or 60 credits incl. gen-ed

graduate: FIU M.S. Hospitality Management (articulation from MDC BAS - Hospitality)

stages.stage: MDC BAS Supervision & Management (60 upper cr)

total.years: 2 to AS; ~7 to chef with experience

certifications: ServSafe Food Protection Manager (common employer requirement)
ACF Certified Culinarian -> Sous Chef -> Executive Chef
experience: FSS 2381 internship and FSS 2940 externship built into the AS

alternative_pathways.name: Chef Apprentice

careers.title: Cybersecurity Professional
careers.summary: CCC Cybersecurity Analyst -> AS Cybersecurity (25079) -> MDC B.S. Cybersecurity (S9515) -> M.S. via agreements.

career_exploration.local_pay_note: MDC cites $89,754 South Florida security-analyst median

related_careers.title: Digital forensics / SOC analyst / penetration tester

primary_program.name: Cybersecurity
primary_program.electives: 9 credits: any CAI, CGS, CIS, COP, CTS (e.g. COP 1334, COP 2800, CTS 1145, CTS 2670/2671, CIS 2619)

mdc_bachelor.name: Cybersecurity
admission: AA, AS, or 60+ credits incl. gen-ed
C or higher in CTS 1120, CTS 1134, CTS 1111 + one of CIS 1531 / COP 1334 / COP 1047C
graduation: C or better in gen-ed and upper division
sources: MDC S9515 program sheet and CSG (Spring 2025)

experience: Help-desk or SOC internships during the AS
professional_development.notes: Exam costs may be reimbursable; credit for prior certifications may be available.
